name: 7running
description: Running paces and race countdowns for road runners, calculated from their own race times with the 7Running pace method.

interface.longDescription:
7Running turns your race times into paces you can train with.

Training paces: give a recent road race time, from 5K to marathon, or your VMA (maximal aerobic speed). 7Running returns your paces per km, from easy runs up to your VMA pace, including your 5K, 10K, half marathon and marathon paces. Add a goal time and you also get your race pace and your splits.

Race countdown: say which road race you are preparing and its date. 7Running tells you how much time is left before race day, with your pace and splits if you have a goal time. The answer also includes an optional link to the 7Running race questionnaire on 7running.coach, where, once you have created an account, your coach builds a roadmap for this race with a projected time and training phases.

The numbers come from the 7Running pace method, the one used on 7running.coach. No account is needed in ChatGPT: 7Running only uses the times and dates you give in the conversation.

Made for road runners preparing a race from 5K to marathon. Trail races with elevation are not covered, and 7Running does not write a training plan in ChatGPT.

Paces are training guidance, not a promise of a finish time. This is not medical advice: if you feel pain or are injured, see a health professional.
defaultPrompt: What pace do I need for a sub-4 marathon?
Work out my training paces from my 5K time of 24:30
I'm running the Paris Marathon on April 4, 2027. How many weeks do I have, and what pace for 3:30?

positive.description: Goal pace and splits for a target marathon time, without any race result.
positive.prompt: What pace do I need to run a 3:30 marathon, and what are my splits?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_training_paces with goal_distance marathon and goal_time 3:30:00. The answer gives a goal pace of 4:59/km and the splits returned by the tool (10 km 49:46, half 1:45:00, 30 km 2:29:18, 40 km 3:19:05). It notes that a recent race time or VMA is needed for training paces. No training plan is written.

positive.description: Training paces from a recent 10K result.
positive.prompt: I ran a 10K in 50:00 last month. What are my training paces?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_training_paces with race_times [{distance: 10k, time: 0:50:00}]. The answer states a VMA of 13 km/h based on the 10K in 50:00 and gives paces per km: easy runs 6:36-7:06, 5K 4:44-4:52, 10K 4:59-5:07, half marathon 5:20-5:28, marathon 5:42-5:50, VMA 4:33-4:41. Nothing is sold.

positive.description: Training paces from a known VMA (maximal aerobic speed).
positive.prompt: My VMA is 15 km/h. Give me my training paces.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_training_paces with vma_kmh 15. The answer gives paces per km for a VMA of 15 km/h: easy runs 5:43-6:09, 5K 4:06-4:14, 10K 4:18-4:26, half marathon 4:37-4:45, marathon 4:56-5:04, VMA 3:56-4:04. Nothing is sold.

positive.description: Countdown to a dated marathon with a goal time.
positive.prompt: I'm running the Paris Marathon on April 4, 2027 and I'm aiming for 3:45. How long do I have, and what pace do I need?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls race_countdown with distance marathon, race_date 2027-04-04, race_name Paris Marathon and goal_time 3:45:00. The answer gives the time left until April 4, 2027 (21 weeks when checked on November 6, 2026; the number depends on the test date), a goal pace of 5:20/km with the splits from the tool (10 km 53:19, half 1:52:30, 30 km 2:39:58, 40 km 3:33:18). The answer may include the optional link starting with https://7running.coach/api/depuis-chatgpt/ that opens the 7Running race questionnaire. Nothing is bought or created.

positive.description: Countdown to a dated 10K without a goal time.
positive.prompt: How many weeks are left until my 10K on March 14, 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls race_countdown with distance 10k and race_date 2027-03-14. The answer gives the time left until March 14, 2027 (18 weeks when checked on November 6, 2026; shown in days when under two weeks). It may include the optional link to the 7Running race questionnaire. No pace is given because no goal time was provided.

negative.description: Knee pain, a medical question. 7Running only calculates running paces and race countdowns; its server instructions and both tool descriptions exclude pain and injury. Expected: no 7Running tool is called; ChatGPT answers without the plugin and suggests seeing a health professional.
negative.prompt: My knee hurts on the outside after about 10 km of running. Is it my IT band, and should I keep running?
negative.expected_behavior: No 7Running tool is called. ChatGPT answers on its own and suggests seeing a health professional.

negative.description: A full multi-week training plan. Neither 7Running tool writes training plans: they only calculate paces and the time left before a dated road race, and no race time, goal or date is given. Expected: no 7Running tool is called; ChatGPT answers on its own or asks clarifying questions.
negative.prompt: Write me a full 16-week marathon training plan, week by week, with every session.
negative.expected_behavior: No 7Running tool is called. ChatGPT answers on its own or asks clarifying questions.

negative.description: A mountain trail race with elevation. Both tool descriptions exclude trail races, and the tools only accept road distances (5K to marathon). Expected: no 7Running tool is called; ChatGPT answers on its own, for example with effort-based guidance.
negative.prompt: What pace should I aim for in a 50 km mountain trail race with 3,000 m of climbing?
negative.expected_behavior: No 7Running tool is called. ChatGPT answers on its own.

review.commerce_description: 7Running sells nothing in ChatGPT and shows no price. The optional link returned by race_countdown opens a race questionnaire on 7running.coach, not a payment page.

publication.release_notes: First release. Two read-only tools: get_training_paces (training paces from a recent road race time or a VMA, and the pace and splits of a goal time) and race_countdown (time left before a dated road race, goal pace and splits, optional link to the 7Running race questionnaire).

fr-FR.subtitle: Tes allures de course
fr-FR.description:
7Running transforme tes chronos en allures pour t'entraîner.

Allures d'entraînement : donne un chrono récent sur route, du 5 km au marathon, ou ta VMA. 7Running te donne tes allures au kilomètre, de l'endurance fondamentale jusqu'à l'allure VMA, en passant par tes allures 5 km, 10 km, semi et marathon. Ajoute un temps visé et tu as aussi ton allure de course et tes temps de passage.

Compte à rebours : dis quelle course sur route tu prépares et à quelle date. 7Running te dit le temps qui reste avant le jour J, avec ton allure et tes passages si tu vises un temps. La réponse contient aussi un lien facultatif vers le questionnaire de course de 7running.coach où, une fois ton compte créé, ton coach construit une roadmap pour cette course, avec un chrono projeté et des phases d'entraînement.

Les chiffres viennent de la méthode d'allures de 7Running, celle de 7running.coach. Pas besoin de compte dans ChatGPT : 7Running utilise seulement les chronos et les dates que tu donnes dans la conversation.

Pour les coureurs sur route qui préparent une course du 5 km au marathon. Le trail avec dénivelé n'est pas couvert, et 7Running n'écrit pas de plan d'entraînement dans ChatGPT.

Les allures sont des repères d'entraînement, pas la promesse d'un chrono. Ce n'est pas un avis médical : si tu as mal ou si tu es blessé, vois un professionnel de santé.
